author: blu
body: The read half of the real repository tools: it opens the fact store on the attached disk, rebuilds the index by replaying the log, walks the tree, and prints the current version of every path -- the source, exactly as it was stored, checked out of a block device with no Perforce in the chain. Paired with cdx-store it is a round trip: a file goes in through one and comes back out through the other.
